tempo.basis: from four complete recordings, median 0:57.5 (Quasthoff/Szidon 1:04, Maltman/Johnson 0:53, Grahl/Heide 1:02, Prégardien/Staier 0:51), 1.5 s allowed for silence; Schumann marks it Nicht schnell

phrases: From my tears spring up many blossoming flowers,
aʊs ˈmaɪnən ˈtrɛːnən ˈʃpriːsən fiːl ˈblyːəndə ˈbluːmən hɛrˈfoːr
and my sighs become a chorus of nightingales.
ʊnt ˈmaɪnə ˈzɔʏftsər ˈveːrdən aɪn ˈnaxtɪɡalənkoːr
ʊnt vɛn duː mɪç liːp hast
little one, I'll give you all the flowers,
ˈkɪntçən ʃɛŋk ɪç diːr diː ˈbluːmən al
and before your window the nightingale's song shall sound.
ʊnt foːr ˈdaɪnəm ˈfɛnstər zɔl ˈklɪŋən das liːt deːr ˈnaxtɪɡal
notes: Words by Heinrich Heine, from Lyrisches Intermezzo (1822–23). IPA follows sung German (Bühnenaussprache): r rolled or flipped, final -er as [ər], ch after front vowels [ç]. Literal translation, for meaning.
